## Design note

The paddy wagon. Three tonnes of long van with a steel cell in the back: slow to speed, slow to stop and it wallows through junctions, but nothing small moves it. It does not chase; it turns up where the chase ends, blocks the lane and waits.

## How this car breaks

Body-on-frame with steel bumpers: frontal and rear hits crumple the short nose and the doors while the frame stays straight. The prisoner cell behind the partition is body structure, not passenger cell, so rear and side hits dent the box deeply without ending the van. The tall flat side is an easy target and the high CG tips it in hard swerves.

## Sources (type)

- manufacturer spec-class data for 2010s extended full-size vans
- upfitter weight data for prisoner-transport inserts (class-typical)
- engineering tables (truck tire radius, leaf/coil ride frequency, caliper hydraulics)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| Axis | Box (kg·m²) | k | `inertia_kgm2` |
|---|---|---|---|
| roll | 2099 | 0.85 | 1780 |
| pitch | 10646 | 0.95 | 10110 |
| yaw | 10554 | 0.97 | 10240 |

6.0 L OHV 16-valve V8, naturally aspirated, heavy-duty van calibration. Class-typical 2010s 6.0 L van V8 (~43 kW/L, ~255 kW at 5200 rpm, ~505 N·m at 4000) per manufacturer spec-class data.

## Drivetrain

6-speed automatic with lock-up torque converter, open rear differential. Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: open. Torque converter: stall 2200 rpm, 2.0× at stall, couples 1:1 from 2600 rpm (class-typical for the gearbox). Clutch capacity 1.60 × peak torque = 810 N·m. Shift time 0.33 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |

| 1 | 4.03 | 13.78 | 57 |
| 2 | 2.36 | 8.07 | 97 |
| 3 | 1.53 | 5.23 | 150 |
| 4 | 1.15 | 3.93 | 199 |
| 5 | 0.85 | 2.91 | 270 |
| 6 | 0.67 | 2.29 | 342 |

Final drive 3.42, reverse 3.06. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.371 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.28 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 733 kg | 1.30 Hz | 48900 N/m | 3350 N·s/m | 5020 N·s/m | 0.20 m |
| Rear | 651 kg | 1.55 Hz | 61700 N/m | 3550 N·s/m | 5320 N·s/m | 0.22 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 5.0°/g with 70% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.741 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 248282 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 73200 F / 91269 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **33600 F / 0 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 4.7°/g, front share 66%. Bump stops 350000 N/m.

Alignment: camber +0.0° F / +0.0° R, toe +0.10° F / +0.00° R (+ = in), caster 4.0°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 345 mm disc, pistons per side 57 mm + 57 mm → A = 51.0 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 148 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·51.0 cm²·0.147 m = **6022 N·m**
- Rear: 345 mm disc, pistons per side 54 mm → A = 22.9 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 148 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·22.9 cm²·0.147 m = **2702 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 3983 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.51×), rear needs 1449 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.86×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 2191 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.552** → delivered 6020 N·m front / 2191 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 1620 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 18.0:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 15.2 m → outer-front path radius 7.48 m, rear-axle-centre radius 5.49 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.622 rad (35.7°)** (outer 31.8°, inner 40.4° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.70). Rack speed 1.1 rad/s.

## Damage lattice (`data/lattices/sentinel_warden.json`)

327 nodes, 2148 beams, 8 detachables, 21 component mounts.

- Generated with `gen-lattice --id sentinel_warden --profile suv --width 2.01 --length 6.2 --height 2.1 --wheelbase 3.94 --mass 655.9 --car-mass 2981.4 --clearance 0.2 --front-overhang 0.9 --strength 1.3` (22% of vehicle mass in the lattice; strength from durability class 5).
- Era `2010s`: gen-lattice's default HSS passenger cell kept as is.
- Steel hood: 132 hood beams aluminum → mild_steel.
- Chrome steel bumpers: 180 bumper beams pp_bumper → mild_steel.
- Detachables: steel bumpers ×2.3 break impulse / ×4 mass; steel hood ×1.4 / ×1.6.
- Body-on-frame: 20 cab-floor rail nodes relabelled FrameLeft/FrameRight; 18 under-cab rail beams → hss 4.19e-04 m² so the ladder frame runs bumper to bumper.
- Cargo box: 40 Cabin nodes behind the seat partition (y < -0.14 m, just behind the front doors) relabelled FrameRear — the passenger cell is the cab only, so cargo-box hits are body damage, not cabin intrusion.
